answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. One name, one proof, one entry: Accredited horn worker order seal enforces it, and a seal workers carry after horn inspections is how the check runs. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Each attempt carries a fare of £22 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. One summit, one entry. The terrace is checked, not assumed. ember is written on the receipt.
